articles.title: Global tourist hub set to be developed in Delhi at cost of Rs 500 crore in three years
articles.summary: The Delhi government is embarking on a significant initiative to transform the city into a global tourist destination. The plan involves private sector-led development, supported by performance-linked incentives, to vigorously promote Delhi's historical monuments, vibrant markets, and diverse cuisine. This strategic approach aims to significantly boost tourism, generate employment opportunities, and enhance national economic growth, demonstrating a model for urban development through public-private partnerships.

articles.title: Damon Lindelof Apologizes for ‘Lanterns’ Controversy: ‘The Joke Was Dumb, The Fandom Is Not’
articles.summary: Damon Lindelof, co-creator of the upcoming HBO series "Lanterns," has apologized for past podcast jokes concerning the show's perceived "lack of green powers." His apology resurfaced amid ongoing discussions among fans and critics regarding the show's direction and potential deviation from traditional Green Lantern mythology, particularly concerning the iconic power rings and their abilities.

articles.title: Starmer, Zelenskyy urge ‘focus’ on Ukraine as Iran war diverts attention
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy met British Prime Minister Starmer in London to sign a new defence pact. This agreement aims to strengthen Ukraine's security amidst its ongoing conflict, ensuring continued support from key allies. The pact was signed as concerns grow that potential wider regional conflicts, like a US-Israeli confrontation with Iran, could divert crucial international attention and resources from Ukraine.

articles.title: Jinjer Announce North American Tour
articles.summary: Ukrainian metal band Jinjer is embarking on an extensive North American tour this summer to promote their latest album, 'Duel'. The tour will span nearly 40 cities across the United States and Canada, signifying an international cultural exchange. While primarily an entertainment event, it demonstrates cross-border artistic movement, with a Ukrainian group engaging audiences abroad.

articles.title: Damon Lindelof Responds to Grant Morrison Backlash Over LANTERNS: “Green Is F–ing Awesome”
articles.summary: Damon Lindelof, co-creator and writer of "Lanterns," is stepping in to address a sharp turn in public conversation surrounding the project. Reports indicate a recent comment about the title sparked controversy, prompting Lindelof to set the record straight amidst ongoing discussions. The details of the 'spar' or specific comments remain unclear from the provided text.

articles.title: Orange: Transactions carried out as part of a share buyback program and outside of a liquidity contract
articles.summary: Orange, a major telecommunications company, announced from Paris on March 16, 2026, the completion of a share buyback program. The company acquired its own treasury shares, a strategic financial move often aimed at boosting shareholder value and demonstrating corporate confidence. This transaction was notably conducted outside of a liquidity contract, highlighting careful capital management.

articles.title: Lindelof Responds To “Lanterns” Criticism
articles.summary: Emmy winner Damon Lindelof, co-creator of HBO's upcoming 'Lanterns' series, has issued an apology for a joke he previously made regarding the show's name change. Set within the expansive DC Universe, the series is envisioned to offer a more grounded narrative. Lindelof's apology addresses the controversy surrounding his earlier comments about the series' evolving title, ensuring clearer communication for fans.

articles.title: Iran official who warned they would 'eliminate' Donald Trump in assassination threat killed in airstrike
articles.summary: Reports indicate an Iranian official, known for threatening Donald Trump, has reportedly been neutralized following recent airstrikes in Iran. This development comes amidst escalating tensions between the US and Iran, suggesting a potential military response to prior threats and further volatility in the region. Aspirants should note such events reflect complex international relations and their defence implications.
